tool.name: MRD HTML report
tool.description: interactive report of an MRD run, grouped by patient

param.name: report
param.label: Final MRD report table
param.help: The tab-separated report of the MRD workflow ('Read families' output), one row per sample, with header line.

param.name: sample_table
param.label: Sample table
param.help: Optional. Fills in H number, primer and marker of samples that the workflow lost, so that every sample appears under its patient.

param.name: corrections
param.label: Sample table corrections
param.help: Optional. The 'Sample table corrections' output of the workflow; shown as a separate box in the report.

param.name: run_name
param.label: Run name
param.help: Shown in the report header, e.g. MRD2026-034.

param.name: workflow_name
param.label: Workflow name and version
param.help: Shown in the report header, e.g. MRD workflow fall 2026 v25.

section.name: wetlab
section.title: Wet-lab verdict
section.help: Limits for the wet-lab verdict (information for the lab; they do not change any result).

param.name: min_mapped
param.label: Minimum mapped / all reads
param.help: Below: much of the sequencing output does not map (adapter or primer dimers, contamination).

param.name: min_on_target
param.label: Minimum reads at the target site / mapped reads
param.help: Below: the primers amplify off target.

param.name: min_quality
param.label: Minimum reads passing the quality filter / all reads

param.name: min_families
param.label: Minimum read families / all reads
param.help: Below: few distinct molecules (low DNA input or over-amplification).

tool.help:
**What it does**
The report has two tabs.
- *Results*: the decision per sample, grouped by patient, with the **decision QC** for the physician. It uses only the reads that count for the marker (UMI read families at the target site, mapping and base quality), however many reads were sequenced in total. - *Wet-lab QC*: did sequencing, primers and library work? All sequenced reads against mapped reads, reads at the target site, the quality filter and read families, with a verdict per sample (OK / Check) and per primer. Information for the lab; it does not change any result.
The tabs and the menu entries show one section at a time in the centre panel (a patient in the menu: that patient only); search and filters show the matching patients. Tables scroll inside their box with the column headers fixed; A-, A and A+ in the header change the font size of the whole report.
Writes one HTML file from the final report table of the MRD workflow. The file contains all data, styles and scripts and needs no internet connection.
- Header with run name, workflow version, time of creation, a search field and filters (detected, physician review, warnings). - Colour code for every sample and patient (H number): green = mutation detected and all QC criteria passed; orange = detected, physician review (non-exact match or warning); red = a QC criterion failed; red "!" = sample not processed (pipeline failure); green "ND" = QC passed, not detected. A patient shows the most important code of its samples. - For every sample that is not green, the reason in words: which QC criterion failed with its value (e.g. reads on marker chromosome 0.068 below 0.95), why a sample is under review (exact match but VarDict FILTER not PASS, non-exact or partial FLT3-ITD match, pipeline warning), or why it was not processed. A sample whose marker signal is present but removed by the quality cutoffs ("Low-quality evidence at marker") is shown as QC failed with the evidence. A sample whose marker the workflow finds only in its second analysis without quality cutoffs ("Found only without quality cutoffs") is QC failed with the call of that analysis, and the Wet-lab QC tab marks it "Repeat": the Phred 30 result is the reported one, the sample goes back to the wet lab. The reasons are listed under each patient, in the sample table and in the chart tooltips. - With and without quality cutoffs: VAF of every marker call with the Phred 30 cutoffs and without any quality cutoff side by side, and the samples to repeat. - A run overview with the number of detected, review, not detected and warning samples. - The corrections the workflow made to the sample table, if that output is given. - General QC of the run, each metric with median, minimum, maximum and the samples below the workflow threshold. All reads of the sample (after demultiplexing and primer trimming, before any quality filter): number of reads, mapped / all reads, on the marker chromosome / all reads, reads at the target site (threshold 200,000) and at the target site / all reads, share passing the fastp quality filter (columns "ALL ..."; shown when the report contains them). Read families and filtered reads: number of reads, reads per read family, mapped / total, on the marker chromosome, depth at the marker, VAF. - QC tab: run summary (medians), a read funnel per sample (all sequenced reads, mapped, on the marker chromosome, at the target site, read families; as share of all reads, for the wet-lab quality) and the UMI read-family size distribution (families of 1, 2, 3, 4-5, 6-10, more than 10 read pairs), when the report carries these columns. - Charts without any external library: one metric per sample with threshold and run median, and a scatter plot of any two metrics (linear or log). Hover shows the values, a click opens the sample. - One card per patient with all samples: primer, marker, "Mutation detected", VAF, depth, mapped / total, on target, match type, physician review and pipeline status. Further columns can be added. A click on a sample shows its QC against the run and every column of the report, grouped (marker and call, QC criteria, FLT3, read families, raw reads, read counts at the marker, barcodes). - A table of all samples with all columns, sortable by any column. - The search field searches every column.
**Inputs**
- *Final MRD report table*: tab separated, header line, one row per sample. Columns are found by name (sample, PatientId, Primer, DNAPosition, AF, DP, Mutation detected, marker_match_type, physician_review, pipeline_status, ...); missing columns are left empty. - *Sample table* (optional): the CSV sample sheet of the run. Samples that the workflow lost keep their H number, primer and marker. - *Sample table corrections* (optional): the CSV listing of corrected fields.
**Display in Galaxy**
Galaxy removes scripts from HTML outputs unless the tool is on the sanitize allowlist (Admin, Manage Allowlist). Without that, download the file and open it in a browser.
